text_block_list.text:
A few days had passed since Tanino 
Gimlet's sudden announcement to take a 
break—

"...Hard training continues unabated in 
pursuit of an absolute victory in the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn)."

Today, as always, Symboli Kris S solemnly 
devotes herself entirely to training, 
without cutting a single corner.

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"—Farewell! Farewell, world! Farewell, my 
beloved observers! Beyond this 
intoxication, gaze upon my imperishable 
light—!"

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"Gimlet-san! Just a few more words!" 
"Please, say something to your fans!!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ......Gimlet――

...The look on her face when she heard the 
news about Tanino Gimlet. In the depths of 
her eyes, I sensed something akin to a 
newfound resolve.

"That was likely the determination to 
press forward on one's own path unchanged, 
without being bewildered by the loss of a 
peer—"

I must follow her example. With the Tenno 
Sho (Autumn) just around the corner, I 
brace myself once again.

"...Today, in between training sessions, 
an interview with Symboli Kris S was being 
conducted."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
――So you are continuing your preparations 
toward the Tenno Sho (Autumn). How do you 
rate your chances of victory at this 
point?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Tough races—are unavoidable. That is 
why—I will continue to... do my best.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Tanino Gimlet-san's announcement of taking 
a break must have come as quite a shock. 
What are your thoughts on this?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...I will—as always, simply do— what I 
must do."

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Um... By that— do you mean Tanino 
Gimlet-san taking a break has no effect on 
you personally?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

...She is definitely not lying. Symboli 
Kris S carries out her mission under any 
circumstances. She's just that kind of 
Umamusume.

A few days later. Our worries came true in 
the worst possible way—

text_block_list.name: Social Media Post
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't Symboli Kris S being a bit too cold 
toward Tanino Gimlet in this interview? I 
actually feel kinda bad for her."

text_block_list.name: Social Media Post
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm, she might have her hands full with 
her own stuff, but I feel like she 
could've said a little more than that."

...Ever since the interview was published, 
the voices calling Symboli Kris S "cold" 
have only grown in number.

"—After this incident, Symboli Kris S was 
occasionally seen lost in thought during 
training."

This was a change unseen in her before 
now. Perhaps even for her, this incident 
had left a deep impression—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Sorry. ...I had... distracting thoughts. 
I'll switch gears... immediately—
choice_data_list:
If you don't mind, tell me what you were 
thinking about

If you don't mind, tell me what you were 
thinking about

text_block_list.text:
Precisely because this was an 
unprecedented change, I needed to put it 
into words and understand it properly. 
With that thought, I looked into her eyes 
and made a suggestion.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Understood.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――I'm not sure. ...I still don't 
understand.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I was... indebted to Gimlet. ...I felt a 
debt of gratitude towards him.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Because Gimlet showed me such powerful 
running... such passion...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of my mission... I felt I had 
to surpass it... and aimed for the Tenno 
Sho (Autumn)...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to... repay that kindness. That's 
why—I had intended—to keep walking my own 
path, unchanged.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Yet—I am cold. ...Which is to say—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I wondered... if I was betraying... the 
favor Gimlet did for me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. Am I... in the wrong... toward 
Gimlet...?

—Symboli Kris S should have told Tanino 
Gimlet before that she was running in this 
year's Tenno Sho (Autumn).
choice_data_list:
...Didn't anyone say anything to you at 
that time?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...When that time comes—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —"Walk your own path," is it?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Yes—that's what they said...
choice_data_list:
Then you're not in the wrong at all, Kris 
S.

text_block_list.text:
Tanino Gimlet is an Umamusume who speaks 
in cryptic phrasing. But she never tells 
lies or stirs up trouble for no reason.

The words spoken to Symboli Kris S were 
surely Tanino Gimlet's honest feelings.
choice_data_list:
Gimlet is counting on you to do great 
things.

Gimlet is counting on you to do great 
things.

text_block_list.text:
Therefore, Symboli Kris S forging straight 
ahead on her own path should also be the 
answer to Tanino Gimlet's expectations.

As a one-of-a-kind presence who competed 
with Tanino Gimlet in the Derby, sharing 
in a once-in-a-lifetime, precious race.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...Thanks. Thanks to you... I've gained 
confidence."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Never wavering— Stronger than ever before—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I will walk—"my own path."

I felt the light of resolve grow stronger 
once again within Symboli Kris S—
...That night.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(...My running style for the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn) is finally coming together.)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(Now, I just need to eliminate my own 
uncertainties and maintain my usual 
condition for the real thing—)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: —Uoooooooooh!!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...―― Dammit...! I can't run 
like Gimlet-senpai at all...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Back during the Derby, you were more 
like... BAM! Like that...—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Nnnrgh!! No!! That's not it!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If it were Gim-senpai... She wouldn't cry 
at a time like this... over something like 
this...! She's totally cool, no matter 
what happens!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Me too...!! I'm gonna be like that 
too--!!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(Vodka... She seemed to really look up to 
Gimlet. ...She must have a lot on her 
mind.)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Don't you think it's beautiful?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"The frenzy brought forth by my brilliance 
shatters common sense and carves guidance 
into pure souls—"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"And that is how the concept of 'myself' 
comes to encompass both the fleeting 
moment and eternity."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Gimlet...—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...So she, too—was influenced by your 
fervor, was she?"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hoh. ...You're finally starting to 
understand.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: "...No. I... understand nothing at all."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Why... did you stop running?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Heh, I see. The true reason destiny 
whispered to me and guided me here wasn't 
Vodka, but you—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Very well, Kris S. It seems you are one 
destined to behold my abyss. Thus, I shall 
tell you. But the answer is simple—"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"I did what had to be done. And I paid the 
price for it. ...That is all."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...A price to pay, you say.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Yes. By burning through every ounce of 
potential dwelling within these legs and 
striking a pact to step down from the 
stage where the shining stars gather, I 
forged a brilliant, fleeting radiance.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
And the price I paid... is that I am now 
sitting here in the shadows.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
However! Satsuki Sho, NHK Mile Cup, Nippon 
Derby! In all of them, I stirred my soul 
and fully demonstrated my raison d'être!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Through that vividly intense, bloody 
battle, the world learned, and the 
observers witnessed! My 
brilliance—threatened by no one—!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The memory of Tanino Gimlet, which no one 
can overwrite! My very "aptitude" that 
leads countless futures into chaos!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: "And I— have already found a new chaos—"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Do you understand, Kris S? I have— already 
completed the "revolution" you speak of.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
And now, here I am... sipping from my cup, 
gazing out upon the chain of chaos born 
from destruction.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I see... So that was it, was it— You, as 
well—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh, interpret it however you like. 
Telling you this much was merely my 
gratitude. To you, who graced my battle 
history as a worthy opponent.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Come autumn, you'll be strong. A piece of 
my soul whispers it to me. Gorge yourself 
on glory to your heart's content, and 
stride forward on your path—into the 
"next" realm!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Then I shall melt once more into the 
shadows of the night. Farewell—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Wait.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Ngh!? This crushing pressure is...!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Gimlet...—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Kris S, you...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...Just as you said— From now on, I will 
walk my own path."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
To carry out my mission—my "revolution"... 
I will demonstrate a strength—that defies 
common sense.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
A strength so great... it overwrites your 
memories.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—I have no intention of stopping. That is 
my... respect—to you.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Heh, heheh, hahahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
What...! What merciless, cold, absolute 
resolve!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Very well...! Show me what you've got, 
Kris S!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
With your "revolution"! Overwrite my 
"proof of existence"! Show me you can do 
it!!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —When that time comes, what will you do?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh— Wherever we stand at that moment, 
that will be our "answer."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
From the deep darkness... I shall listen 
to the melody trodden by your steps――

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Fufu, hahahaha! HAHHHH-HA-HA-HA-HA!!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...I will fulfill it, without fail.
